name: DependencyInfo
description: Represents the dependency information for an AccessObject object.
remarks: To return the dependency information for an AccessObject object, use the GetDependencyInfo method of the AccessObject object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Dependants
properties.description: Returns a DependencyObjects collection that represents the objects that depend on the specified AccessObject object. Read-only.

properties.name: Dependencies
properties.description: Returns a DependencyObjects collection that represents the objects that the specified AccessObject object depends on. Read-only.

properties.name: OutOfDateObjects
properties.description: Returns a DependencyObjects collection that represents the AccessObject objects for which the dependency information is outdated. Read-only.

properties.name: InsufficientPermissions
properties.description: Returns a DependencyObjects collection that contains a collection of objects to which you don't have sufficient permissions to check for dependencies. Read-only.

properties.name: UnsupportedObjects
properties.description: Returns a DependencyObjects collection that contains objects that cannot be searched for dependency. Read-only.
